notes.json_numbers: HTTP JSON unmarshals into map[string]any via encoding/json, so every JSON number arrives as float64. Helpers that accept float64 (and optionally int64) and reject strings are recorded as json_type integer. Sending the string "3" is a 422.
notes.max_elements_default: editing.DefaultMaxElements = 200 (editing/registry.go:111). asArray/asArrayN use editspec.maxListElements which aliases that constant (editspec/curated.go:103). FieldSpec.MaxElements is not rewritten at Register time; the effective cap is the one Validate enforces.
notes.max_suppressed_default: editing.maxSuppressedKeys = 200 (editing/suppression.go:16). SuppressedFieldSpec copies parent.MaxSuppressed, or that default when the parent left it 0 (editing/suppression.go:46-49).
notes.policy: No FieldSpec in catalog/editspec sets Policy; every field inherits EntityTypeSpec.DefaultPolicy. SiteOverlays overlay every registered key of that type, including .suppressed companions, because the overlay maps are built from the same Fields slice the companions are appended to.
